description: Live departure or arrival board for a GB railway station, from National Rail's Darwin feed: booked time, expected time, actual time once reported, platform, operator and any delay or cancellation reason. With 'to', only trains that also call at that station are listed, each with its booked, expected and actual time there: the live answer to 'next train from Bolton to Darwen'. On an arrivals board, 'to' is where the train came from. An expected time equal to the booked one means no revision has been published, which usually means running to plan. A missing expected time is not a statement that the train is on time. Reasons are National Rail's own wording.

includeNonPassenger.description: Include empty stock, freight and staff trains.

station.description: Station name, CRS code (KGX) or TIPLOC.

to.description: Optional second station (name or CRS): only trains that call there after this one on departures, or before it on arrivals.
